newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-RAGUTIS H1 PROFIT 2.8 MLN LITAS.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-RAGUTIS H1 PROFIT 2.8 MLN LITAS.

text.p: Lithuanian brewer Ragutis said on Wednesday that its profits for the first half of 1997 rose to 2.8 million litas from 1.5 million litas in the same period last year.
"Our sales increased by about 20 percent in this period," Ragutis Finance Director Marchelo Vivado told Reuters. "We also had an increase in prices."
Vivado said Ragutis was also benefiting from cooperation with Plzensky Praztroj (Pilsner Urquell), which bought 51 percent of the Kaunas-based brewery in January.
"We are also producing beers which go faster through the production lines," Vivado said. "We are coming out with beers that have less alcohol."
According to Vivado, Ragutis controls 11 percent of Lithuania's beer market.
